Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated RDW and basophils, suggesting possible bone marrow dysfunction or myelodysplasia. Elevated ferritin and CRP indicate inflammation. Electrolytes, renal, and liver function are within normal limits. Coagulation is stable (INR therapeutic), but low PT may reflect anticoagulation. Overall, findings suggest chronic inflammatory or hematologic disorder; clinical correlation and further hematologic evaluation are recommended.
